patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Delete the 'pr5.rpyc' file from within the 'game' folder mentioned above Download the patch file from the link below Move the downloaded patch file into the 'game' folder mentioned above
